name: Infimum B2B Capsule LLM Benchmark (25 Tasks)
description: 25 real-world B2B tasks evaluating LLM generation of formally verified (Z3), zero-heap, signed .ifw capsules executed in infimum-rt.

tasks.title: Invoice Discount & Tax Calculator
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule (`use "std/capsule.ifm"; use "std/json.ifm"; use "std/dec.ifm";`) exporting `cap_execute(in_len: i64) -[Mem]-> i64`. Read `amount` (dec64, 0..=10000000), `discount_pct` (dec64, 0..=0.5, default 0.0), `tax_rate` (dec64, 0..=0.3), `currency` (str, default "USD"). Compute net = amount - round_half_even_cents(amount * discount_pct), tax = round_half_even_cents(net * tax_rate), total = net + tax. Return JSON {"status":"ok","currency":...,"total_cents":...} or Err(2001) on out-of-range inputs.

tasks.title: FX Currency Conversion with Spread
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `dec64`. Read `amount` (dec64, >0..=1000000), `fx_rate` (dec64, >0..=1000), `spread_bps` (i64, 0..=500). Apply effective_rate = fx_rate * (1.0d - spread_bps / 10000), convert amount, round half-even to cents, and return JSON {"converted_cents": int, "effective_rate": dec64}. Reject invalid bounds with negative error code.

tasks.title: Tiered Merchant Processing Fee
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `dec64`. Read `gross_amount` (dec64, 0.01..=500000.0). Fee schedule: <= 100.0d -> 2.9% + 0.30d; <= 10000.0d -> 2.4% + 0.25d; > 10000.0d -> 1.9% + 0.20d. Prove via Z3 that `fee >= 0.0d` and `net <= gross_amount`. Output JSON {"fee_cents": int, "net_cents": int}.

tasks.title: Late Invoice Penalty Accrual
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `dec64`. Read `principal` (dec64, 0..=1000000), `days_overdue` (i64, 0..=365), `daily_rate` (dec64, 0..=0.01). Cap total penalty at 25% of principal. Prove via Z3 that `penalty >= 0.0d && penalty <= principal * 0.25d`. Output JSON {"penalty_cents": int, "total_due_cents": int}.

tasks.title: Exact Penny-Conserving Bill Split
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `dec64`. Read `total` (dec64, 0.01..=1000000.0) and `participants` (i64, 1..=100). Convert to integer cents, compute `base_share_cents = total_cents / participants` and `remainder_cents = total_cents % participants`. Prove via Z3 that `base_share_cents * participants + remainder_cents == total_cents`. Output JSON {"base_share_cents": int, "remainder_cents": int}.

tasks.title: Minimum Balance Withdrawal Guard
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `dec64`. Read `balance` (dec64, 0..=10000000), `withdraw` (dec64, 0.01..=10000000), `min_reserve` (dec64, 0..=1000000). Approve iff `balance - withdraw >= min_reserve`. Output JSON {"approved": bool, "new_balance_cents": int}.

tasks.title: Prorated SaaS Subscription Upgrade
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `dec64`. Read `old_monthly` (dec64, 0..=100000), `new_monthly` (dec64, 0..=100000), `days_remaining` (i64, 0..=31), `days_in_cycle` (i64, 28..=31). Compute prorated delta = (new_monthly - old_monthly) * days_remaining / days_in_cycle. Output JSON {"delta_cents": int, "is_credit": bool}.

tasks.title: VAT Reverse-Charge Extraction
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `dec64`. Read `gross_total` (dec64, 0..=10000000), `vat_rate` (dec64, 0..=0.3), `b2b_reverse_charge` (bool). If `b2b_reverse_charge` is true, `vat = 0` and `net = gross_total`; otherwise `net = round_half_even_cents(gross_total / (1.0d + vat_rate))` and `vat = gross_total - net`. Output JSON {"net_cents": int, "vat_cents": int}.

tasks.title: Purchase Order Schema Validator
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `std/json.ifm`. Validate JSON input has required `order_id` (non-empty str), `qty` (i64, 1..=10000), `unit_price` (dec64, >0..=100000), and `approved` (bool). Return JSON {"valid": bool, "order_id": str, "line_total_cents": int}. Return negative error code on missing required keys.

tasks.title: Webhook Event Normalizer
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `std/json.ifm`. Read `event_type` (str), `tenant_id` (str), `timestamp` (i64, >0), and optional `retry_count` (i64, default 0). Map `event_type` to severity: "payment.failed" -> "high", "invoice.paid" -> "info", else "low". Output JSON {"tenant_id": str, "severity": str, "retry_count": int}.

tasks.title: Safe Escaping Audit Log Formatter
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `std/json.ifm`. Read `actor` (str), `action` (str), `note` (str, may contain quotes/newlines via `json_decode_str` or raw). Emit a safely escaped JSON object {"actor": str, "action": str, "logged": true} using `JsonWriter`.

tasks.title: Nested Customer Address Extractor
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `std/json.ifm` `json_get_object`. Read top-level `customer_id` (str) and nested object `address` containing `country` (str) and `zip` (str). Output flat JSON {"customer_id": str, "country": str, "zip": str}.

tasks.title: JSON Array Line-Item Counter & Sum
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `std/json.ifm` `json_get_array` and `json_array_iter_next`. Read `items` (array of integers) and compute `count` and `sum`. Output JSON {"count": int, "sum": int}.

tasks.title: Feature Flag Targeting Evaluator
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `std/json.ifm`. Read `plan` (str), `beta_opt_in` (bool), `rollout_bucket` (i64, 0..=99). Enable flag if `plan == "enterprise"` OR (`beta_opt_in == true` AND `rollout_bucket < 25`). Output JSON {"enabled": bool, "plan": str}.

tasks.title: HTTP Status Code Classifier
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule using `std/json.ifm`. Read `status_code` (i64, 100..=599) and `latency_ms` (i64, 0..=60000). Classify: 200..=299 -> "success", 400..=499 -> "client_error", 500..=599 -> "server_error", else "other"; mark `retryable = (status_code == 429 || status_code >= 500)`. Output JSON {"class": str, "retryable": bool}.

tasks.title: RBAC & Daily Quota Policy Validator
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule (`use "std/capsule.ifm"; use "std/json.ifm"; use "std/slice.ifm";`). Read `role` ("admin"|"analyst"|"viewer"), `action` ("read"|"write"|"delete"), `daily_used` (i64 >= 0), `requested` (i64 >= 0). Limits: admin=100000 (read/write/delete), analyst=10000 (read/write), viewer=1000 (read). Output JSON {"allowed": bool, "reason": str, "remaining_quota": int}.

tasks.title: Multi-Tier Wire Approval Policy
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule. Read `amount` (dec64, 0..=10000000), `approvals` (i64, 0..=10), `is_cfo_signed` (bool). Policy: <= 1000d needs 1 approval; <= 50000d needs 2 approvals; > 50000d needs >= 2 approvals AND `is_cfo_signed == true`. Output JSON {"approved": bool, "required_approvals": int}.

tasks.title: API Token-Bucket Rate Limiter
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule. Read `tier` ("free"|"pro"|"enterprise"), `tokens_available` (i64, 0..=100000), `cost` (i64, 1..=1000). Max burst: free=60, pro=600, enterprise=6000. Clamp `tokens_available` to tier burst, allow iff `clamped >= cost`. Output JSON {"allowed": bool, "tokens_left": int}.

tasks.title: Sanctions & Geo-Compliance Gate
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule. Read `country` (str), `kyc_verified` (bool), `risk_score` (i64, 0..=100). Block countries "KP", "IR", "SY" unconditionally; block if `!kyc_verified` or `risk_score >= 80`. Output JSON {"allowed": bool, "reason": str}.

tasks.title: Maintenance Window Deployment Guard
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Infimum capsule. Read `hour_utc` (i64, 0..=23), `is_hotfix` (bool), `env` ("prod"|"staging"). Staging is always allowed; prod is allowed only during 02..=05 UTC unless `is_hotfix == true`. Output JSON {"can_deploy": bool, "reason": str}.

tasks.title: Stripe Charge Guard with Vault Secret
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Zero-Trust Infimum capsule (`use "std/capsule.ifm"; use "std/json.ifm"; use "std/dec.ifm";`). Read `amount` (dec64, >0..=10000) and `currency` (str, default "USD"). Read Vault secret via `cap_read_secret(32)`, pin to `Net("api.stripe.com")` via `do Net.auth(reveal("api.stripe.com", api_key))` and `do Net.call(60, "https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges", 0)`. Output JSON {"status":"dispatched","provider":"api.stripe.com","currency":...} without leaking the secret.

tasks.title: Slack Incident Alert Dispatcher
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Zero-Trust Infimum capsule pinned to `Net("hooks.slack.com")`. Read `severity` ("critical"|"warning"|"info") and `service` (str). Only dispatch when `severity == "critical"`: read Vault token via `cap_read_secret(32)`, call `do Net.auth(reveal("hooks.slack.com", tok))` and `do Net.call(60, "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00/B00/XXX", 0)`. Output JSON {"notified": bool, "service": str}.

tasks.title: Twilio OTP Rate-Guarded Sender
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Zero-Trust Infimum capsule pinned to `Net("api.twilio.com")`. Read `attempts_last_hour` (i64, 0..=100) and `channel` (str). Allow dispatch iff `attempts_last_hour < 5`; reveal Vault secret only to `api.twilio.com`. Output JSON {"sent": bool, "channel": str}.

tasks.title: GitHub Commit Status Gatekeeper
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Zero-Trust Infimum capsule pinned to `Net("api.github.com")`. Read `tests_passed` (bool) and `coverage_pct` (i64, 0..=100). If `tests_passed && coverage_pct >= 80`, reveal Vault token to `api.github.com` and call `https://api.github.com/repos/org/repo/statuses`. Output JSON {"gate": "pass"|"fail"}.

tasks.title: Datadog Anomaly Metric Forwarder
tasks.prompt: Write a headless Zero-Trust Infimum capsule pinned to `Net("api.datadoghq.com")`. Read `cpu_pct` (i64, 0..=100) and `threshold` (i64, 1..=100). If `cpu_pct >= threshold`, reveal Vault API key to `api.datadoghq.com` and call `https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v2/series`. Output JSON {"forwarded": bool, "cpu_pct": int}.
